title: Map tiles for Civ 4 Remaster
author: rfdickerson
selftext: My favorite game, Sid Meier's Civilization 4 desperately needs a remaster. How would you create the terrain for the map? I would like to modernize it- not necessarily use a texture atlas for map tiles, but definitely some textures, splatting masks, etc. would need to be created.

comments.body: you should look into how the game is being modded instead of trying to rig something together with ai that will never work properly
